description: Frozen exposures for the DEL-12-02 value-record sweep (value_record_sweep.json), one per case in sweep order, as indices into `exposures` (200 to a line, comma-separated); `contract_decisions` indexes `decision_sets`, each the sorted list of [path, action, reason_code] decisions with the route key prefix removed from paths. An exposure is the spec's: 'B' when blocked, else the sorted key paths and visible scalar leaves of the exported payload, with the route key prefix removed from member names. The *_before columns were captured from the real code at e430375d28 (Python core/security/redaction/route_control.py; TypeScript redactionExportControls.ts). The Rust mirror then had no route projector and does not materialize a payload: it is held to `contract_decisions` case for case, and has no before column. `contract` is the exposure TypeScript and Python give under the value-record rule (HELP_HUMAN decision 2026-10-28: "take the stricter decision per case"; Codex privacy review of #1722) and the reserved-name rule (HELP_HUMAN ruling 2026-10-28: "fail closed on reserved internal names, in all three implementations"). A case is less strict than a before column when it does not block where that column blocked, or exposes a key path or a visible leaf that column did not.
